concepts.name: Mean squared error
concepts.summary: Loss = average of squared differences between prediction and target (the squared L2 distance). Squaring removes sign, punishes big errors most, and gives a smooth slope for gradient descent. (Upstairs: diffusion trains on MSE between true and predicted noise; I-JEPA and VICReg use it too.)

concepts.name: Gradient descent
concepts.summary: Reduce a loss by stepping weights opposite the gradient (steepest ascent): new = old - lr*grad. Backpropagation computes the gradient efficiently. The patient engine training every network in the palace.
